question: Does current V2 satisfy the founding anti-Pseudo-V2 boundary without active dependence on V1 runtime/state/authority?

verification.observation: The deterministic dependency audit classifies active scripts, src, .github and configs as PASS_NO_ACTIVE_V1_RUNTIME_STATE_AUTHORITY_DEPENDENCY. Both V2 test runners use V2-owned offline uv with pinned pytest==8.4.2 and pass focused suites. R9 startup uses V2 scripts/prepare_r9_runtime_secrets.py; RunPod hunter uses V2 scripts/prepare_runtime_secrets.py. MAIN does not own or materialize the ISS password.

decision.interpretation: Current active V2 execution has no identified dependency on V1 runtime, V1 state or V1 authority. Remaining legacy-controller filesystem references are migration/archive or defense-in-depth checks, not active execution authority. Individually qualified legacy-v1-canonical-corpus assets retain provenance and do not confer runtime or governance authority.
decision.scope: Anti-Pseudo-V2 independence boundary for current audited active source and focused runtime paths; no claim of complete FULL-AFK operation or gameplay strength.
decision.legacy_asset_rule: No V1 model, checkpoint or dataset is accepted as V2 merely because it exists or has a V2-like name.
